posts.title: Hasql v2: the Native Era Begins
posts.description: Hasql v2 is here! It can run natively in Haskell with no external dependencies or the same way it always has, using “libpq”. It’s the user’s choice now. No breaking changes in the API except for the choice of the adapter in the connection settings. posts.title: pqi: Making libpq a Choice, Not a Requirement
posts.description: For years, every serious Haskell PostgreSQL driver has been chained to the same C library - libpq - with no clean way out. I tried to cut it loose twice, and both times I failed at the finish line. They say the third time’s the charm. I hope it will be - not because I’ve tried harder, but because I’ve changed the goal. posts.title: My 14-Year Journey Away from ORMs - How I Built pGenie, the SQL-First Postgres Code Generator
posts.description: Hi, I’m Nikita Volkov - architect, consultant, and the author of hasql , one of the two main PostgreSQL drivers in Haskell used in major production projects like PostgREST and IHP.
